title: Cablevision Funds & City Power Review
summary:
*   **Cable TV Settlement Funds:** Council adopted a resolution and guidelines for distributing money received from a cablevision settlement.
*   **Electric Utility Assessment:** A comprehensive report detailing the city's electric utility was presented and discussed.
*   **Major Project & Leadership:** Work sessions focused on updates for the Gilbane Building project, and the search for a new City Manager was also on the agenda, though postponed.

Mayor Pro Tem Trevino called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of
Mayor Cooksey and Councilmember Humphrey.
CABLEVISION SETTLEMENT FUNDS
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Shipman's second,
adopted a resolution utilizing cablevision settlement funds, and approved guidelines for
distribution of cablevision settlement funds. (4-0 Vote, Mayor Cooksey, Councilmember
Humphrey absent, Councilmember Urdy out of the room) ITEMS POSTPONED Postponed until
January 7, 1988 is consideration of executing agreement and estoppel certificate
consenting to transfer of Brackenridge Professional Building ground lease.
The City Manager report on Jail Consolidation was postponed as was the worksession
discussion of City Manager Search.. CITY MANAGER REPORT Council heard a report on
Comprehensive Assessment of the Electric Utility.
WORKSESSION
A worksession was held on Gilbane Building Update. ITEMS NOT CONSIDERED Council did not
have an executive session, nor did they make any board or commission appointments.
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 7:10 p.m.
